In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were '''ambushed''' by a group of [[Catuman]] warriors under the orders of [[Kharys]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]].
